verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a terminal emulator, for example exporting configuration, themes or scrollback, so the axis applies. The pack documents no export or data-portability feature, though. The nearest items are split config files and `ghostty +show-config`, which print or organize configuration rather than export user data in open formats, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
